notes: IVA 15% (IVA Regulation art. 17, Lei 21/VI/2003, Boletim Oficial). Bullion coded 15: the Regulation's exemption articles (12-15) were read - gold appears only in art. 12(1)(e), exempting imports of gold by the Banco de Cabo Verde; there is no investment-gold scheme. Silver 15/15. Duty null (no openable ECOWAS CET 7108 line).

sources.name: Regulamento do Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado (Boletim Oficial, INCV), arts. 12 and 17
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the tax rate is 15%, and the only gold exemption is for imports effected by the Bank of Cabo Verde
sources.quote: A taxa do imposto é de 15%.
